title: Polynomial chart with prescribed fibre dimension
statement: For affine schemes X and T, a locally finitely presented morphism f : X ⟶ T, a point y : X, and a natural number n equal to the dimension of the fibre at y, there is an affine open U containing y and a locally finitely presented, locally quasi-finite morphism e : U ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift (Fin n)) T whose composite with projection equals U.ι ≫ f.

proof.text: Identify f with its coordinate ring map and its scheme-theoretic fibre with the residue-field tensor product spectrum. Transfer the given local dimension equality across these homeomorphisms.
Apply exists_quasiFinite_over_polynomial_algebra to obtain the localized polynomial map quasi-finite at every prime.

Identify the localization spectrum with D(b). Transport its spectrum morphism and rename variables to ULift (Fin n). Algebra compatibility gives the composite identity; RingHom.FinitePresentation.of_comp_finiteType and the affine criteria give local finite presentation and local quasi-finiteness.

theorem exists_quasiFinite_polynomial_chart_data
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine T]
    (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (y : X) (n : ℕ)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber y) = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens) (_ : IsAffine U.toScheme) (hy : y ∈ U)
      (e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T),
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation e ∧ LocallyQuasiFinite e ∧
      e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f
